# New Rally-X for MSX — 1.0.0, compact cartridge and MegaRAM update

The **complete game is now 1,007,616 programmed bytes**, below 1 MiB, with
unchanged graphics, sound assets and gameplay. The cartridge retains **64 KiB
main-RAM compatibility**, automatic expanded-cache selection and supported
Panasonic CPU acceleration.

## Download and play

| Download | Hardware / use |
| --- | --- |
| **newrallyx.rom** | MSX2+/V9958, 128 KiB VRAM, at least **64 KiB main RAM**. Select **ASCII8**. |
| **newrallyx-megaram.zip** | Same machine plus **1 MiB MegaRAM**; only **64 KiB main RAM** needed. MSX-DOS1 or Disk BASIC. |
| **newrallyx-disk.zip** | Preserved earlier **4 MiB standard system-RAM-mapper** edition; no MegaRAM required. |
| **newrallyx-source-overlay.zip** | Authored source/docs/tests and workbook for rebuilding this update against tag 1.0.0. No ROM inputs, BIOS or operating system included. |

The earlier ROM used ASCII16. **This replacement uses ASCII8**; update saved
emulator cartridge settings accordingly. It has 123 × 8 KiB pages and 40,960
bytes of margin below 1 MiB. A 512 KiB MegaRAM is insufficient.

[Play the ASCII8 cartridge in WebMSX](https://webmsx.org/?M=MSX2PJ&P=RAM128&ROM=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsandersouza%2Fmsxgp-newrallyx%2Freleases%2Fdownload%2F1.0.0%2Fnewrallyx.rom&ROM_FORMAT=ASCII8).
Generic MSX2+ turbo OFF is expected; WebMSX is not the timing evidence below.

For openMSX, supply the appropriate BIOS locally and select the mapper:

```sh
openmsx -machine Panasonic_FS-A1WSX -cart newrallyx.rom -romtype ASCII8
```

For the MegaRAM executable, copy all `NRXMEGA.*` files to one disk/SD/CF
directory. Under MSX-DOS run **NRXMEGA**; under Disk BASIC run
**RUN "NRXMEGA.BAS"**. The loader detects primary/expanded MegaRAM slots,
loads and checks the full image, then takes over the machine. Reset to exit.
Supply your own DOS files when needed. DOS2/Nextor and physical-device variants
are not qualified by these DOS1/BASIC checks.

The older standard-mapper archive remains byte-for-byte unchanged. It uses
`NRALLYX` / `RUN "NRALLYX.BAS"` and requires a **4 MiB main RAM mapper**;
system RAM mapper and MegaRAM are separate hardware options.

**Controls:** 5 credit; 1 one player; 2 alternating two-player game (two credits);
arrows/joystick1 steering; Space/Ctrl/triggerA smoke; P pause.

## Size and preservation evidence

The former 2,048,000-byte image mostly spent space on generated renderer data,
precompiled transfers and bank reservations. Independent 8 KiB windows, exact
sharing and audited packing save **1,040,384 bytes (50.8%)**. The arcade's small
CPU program relies on dedicated tile/sprite hardware and separate graphics
resources; its program size is not an equivalent MSX storage budget.

Matched WSX64 workloads with full HUD/audio, real VDP timing and sprite limits:

| Native enemies | Previous / compact presented FPS | Mean work cycles, previous → compact |
| ---: | --- | ---: |
| 3 | 29.966 / 29.966 | 75,838 → 75,557 |
| 5 | 28.872 / 28.872 | 88,177 → 87,868 |
| 6 | 28.701 / 28.701 | 90,412 → 90,136 |

Both cartridge and MegaRAM executable preserve the cadence; P95 and maximum
work also improve in these samples. All 356 rows per population match the
baseline's camera, enemies, elapsed ticks, active state and all 14 PSG registers.
Refresh is **59.922743 Hz**, separate from presented FPS. These short controlled
workloads retain existing heavy-scene tails; they are not a sustained-30-FPS
promise for every scene. Reference-cycle costs are elapsed time × 3,579,545 Hz,
not mixed-clock R800 instruction counts.

Qualification also covers all layouts through round 14, challenge, two-player,
flags/radar/blink, attract, controls, smoke, complete cars, original startup/title
pixels/timing, 14 skip cases, audio/engine/clear fixtures and a 16,000-active-
refresh steering test. All eight maps match byte-for-byte and load 19.2% faster.
A rare pre-existing LD A,I interrupt-state race exposed by the new layout was
fixed before this delivery; final timings include the correction.

Sony64, WSX64/128 and stock turboR ST256/GT512 checks pass. Real disk loading
was tested for DOS1 and BASIC, primary and expanded MegaRAM slots, image
integrity and early rejection of insufficient/corrupt/missing inputs. The older
4 MiB executable was rebuilt identically and rechecked in DOS/BASIC.

**476 general and 94 component tests pass**, with one component skip. The module
ROM/symbol gate passes. A build with generated graphics/scenes/native inputs
absent reproduces the exact cartridge, with zero scene reconstruction mismatches.

These are automated/openMSX 21.0 results. Physical hardware, PAL50 output and
subjective listening/perceptual acceptance remain separate. The qualification
JSON and source overlay identify exact hashes, scopes and reproduction steps.
Older CPU matrices keep their original hashes and are not relabeled as current.
